guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster (right-handed, played upside-down/restrung for left hand)
guitar.evidence: Jimi Hendrix's white Fender Stratocaster (and his left-handed restringing of right-handed Strats) is among the most iconic and exhaustively documented guitar setups in rock history.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown; one of the most famous guitar/guitarist pairings in music history.

tone.target: gated fuzz lead with wah bite and controlled feedback
tone.profile: gated fuzz lead with wah bite and controlled feedback
tone.summary: Fuzz -> Wah -> Boost/OD -> UK 45 Amp -> UK Vintage 4x12 Cab. This setup captures the classic Hendrix sound with controlled feedback and aggressive upper mids.

rig.name: The Jimi Hendrix Experience - Foxey Lady - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise from high-gain fuzz circuits.
Provides the core psychedelic fuzz tone and saturation required for the lead lines.

alternatives.reason: Good alternative if Fuzz is too aggressive, offering more control.

blocks.purpose: Adds the signature 'Cry Baby' wah bite and vocal filtering effect.
Gently boosts the signal before the amp to enhance sustain and upper-mid bite.
blocks.gap: A dedicated EQ boost might be better, but Boost serves as a general volume/tone lift.

alternatives.reason: If more grit than pure sustain is needed.

blocks.purpose: Simulates the classic British Plexi sound (Marshall), providing necessary headroom and aggressive upper mids.

alternatives.reason: A slightly more open, less saturated alternative.

blocks.purpose: Provides the classic British cabinet voicing and punchy response.
Sculpts the tone by emphasizing upper-mids and highs, ensuring maximum bite and cutting through the mix.
Adds a subtle vibrato effect to enhance the sustain and emotional depth without sounding artificial.
blocks.gap: The 'vibrato' is often achieved via pitch modulation, but Tremolo provides a usable, subtle movement.

alternatives.reason: If the vibrato needs to be more sweeping and less rhythmic.

blocks.purpose: Adds a subtle sense of space and dimension without washing out the aggressive fuzz tone.
blocks.gap: The target avoids 'delay wash,' so reverb must be kept minimal to maintain punchiness.

alternatives.reason: A slightly brighter, more controlled ambience.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR for better vintage punch and mid-range definition, crucial for Hendrix's aggressive upper mids.

proposals.reason: Enhance the punch and mid-range bite needed for 'Foxey Lady' lead tones.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in upper mids.
